causalAutopsy.notes: U4.5's key-expiry tier was specified against `tailscale status --json` as a whole and never scoped to mesh-relevant nodes — the tailnet was implicitly assumed to BE the mesh. Latent since U4.5 shipped; it only becomes visible once the operator's tailnet contains a node with a lapsed key that is not a mesh peer, which happened when a device went offline 2026-08-13. The permanent warning was then read as a live finding and relayed to the operator as a real risk on 2026-08-29.
